title: Umbrage Against the Other Machine
description: Umbrage Against the Other Machine — The Townstons wiki
html:
Quest Giver: Colonel Cabo

Quest Type: Kill

Quest Description: Go to the Upper Umbrage Unleashed off Level 4 of MutantMania. Unleash your fury against Osbert the Oppressor and then report back to Colonel Cabo in the MutantMania Training Center.

Quest Reward: Gold

Return to: Colonel Cabo

Repeatable: Yes

Zone: Mutant Mania

In-game text

Journal text, offer, and turn-in as they appeared in game.

Journal: Go to the Upper Umbrage Unleashed off Level 4 of MutantMania. Unleash your fury against Osbert the Oppressor and then report back to Colonel Cabo in the MutantMania Training Center.

Offer:

Friend, you can't become the newest regional champion of the Upper Umbrage Unleashed and not expect every Tom, Dick, and Scary to want to take your title from you. In fact, we want them to want that! Because it's what the crowd wants. And if the crowd wants the fighters to want your title, then we want to fulfill their wants. Ah've booked another fight for you. Go back to Upper Umbrage Unleashed off Level 4 of MutantMania. Osbert the Oppressor thinks he wants to fight you. Go give him what he wants.

Turn-in:

Ah heard Osbert the Oppressor almost took you down. No, Ah wasn't there...Ah've got things to do. A manager can't sit around holding his fighter's hand! Come back in a bit. Ah'll have another fight scheduled.

Objectives:

  • Unleash against Osbert the Oppressor

Level range: 82–92
